about: Known anon-rpc workers published on Ethereum mainnet. This file is the single source for the picker in docs/integrate-wallet.md and the preset list in the live demo. Networks: open a PR adding an entry.

fields.label: one line for a dropdown
fields.note: what this worker is, and what it does not give you
fields.config: optional §7.1 config object, delivered to the worker as-is
fields.configNote: optional caveat about that config (e.g. a shared demo endpoint)

workers.label: Passthrough — plain fetch (no anonymization)
workers.note: The minimal reference worker: it fulfils calls with an ordinary fetch, so requests are not anonymized. It demonstrates the sandbox and hash pinning, not privacy.

workers.label: tor-js — fetch over Tor
workers.note: Runs a full Tor client compiled to WebAssembly inside the sandbox, building circuits in the browser. Expect a bootstrap delay before the first response, and higher per-request latency than a direct fetch, since traffic is relayed through multiple hops.
workers.configNote: Demonstration gateway only: limited capacity, and it may disappear at any time — run your own for anything real. Browsers cannot open the raw TCP that Tor uses, so gateways act as blind KPS relays into the Tor network.
